components.name: Neutral action
components.description: The shipped Reload data action, using neutral surfaces and the inherited body family.
components.css: .ds-action{font:500 15px/1.5 "Red Hat Text", "Segoe UI", sans-serif;min-height:44px;padding:9px 14px;border:1px solid var(--field-border,#707070);border-radius:var(--rh-border-radius-default,3px);cursor:pointer;background:var(--surface,#ffffff);color:var(--ink,#151515);}.ds-action:hover{background:var(--raised,#f2f2f2);}.ds-action:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#0066cc);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-action:disabled{opacity:.6;cursor:wait;}

components.name: Masthead theme action
components.description: The theme control on the persistent black masthead.
components.css: .ds-masthead{padding:16px;background:#151515;}.ds-theme{font:500 16px/1.5 "Red Hat Text", "Segoe UI", sans-serif;min-height:44px;padding:9px 14px;border:1px solid var(--field-border,#707070);border-radius:var(--rh-border-radius-default,3px);cursor:pointer;color:#ffffff;background:transparent;border-color:#c7c7c7;}.ds-theme:hover{background:#383838;border-color:#ffffff;}.ds-theme:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #92c5f9;outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Labelled search and select
components.description: Square native filter fields with persistent labels and a 48px control height.
components.css: .ds-fields{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px;}.ds-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;font:500 14px/1.5 "Red Hat Text", "Segoe UI", sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#151515);min-width:0;flex:1 1 180px;}.ds-field input,.ds-field select{width:100%;min-width:0;height:48px;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--field-border,#707070);border-radius:0;background:var(--surface,#ffffff);color:var(--ink,#151515);font:400 16px/1.5 "Red Hat Text", "Segoe UI", sans-serif;}.ds-field input{caret-color:var(--accent,#0066cc);}.ds-field select{cursor:pointer;}.ds-field input::placeholder{color:var(--muted,#4d4d4d);opacity:1;}.ds-field input:hover,.ds-field select:hover{border-bottom-color:var(--accent,#0066cc);}.ds-field input:focus-visible,.ds-field select:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#0066cc);outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: View navigation
components.description: Pressed-state native buttons use the RHDS red selected underline and a neutral baseline.
components.css: .ds-views{display:flex;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border,#c7c7c7);}.ds-view{font:500 16px/1.5 "Red Hat Text", "Segoe UI", sans-serif;min-height:44px;padding:16px 24px;margin-bottom:-1px;border:0;border-bottom:4px solid transparent;border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:var(--muted,#4d4d4d);cursor:pointer;}.ds-view span{font-size:14px;margin-left:8px;color:var(--muted,#4d4d4d);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}.ds-view-active{color:var(--ink,#151515);border-bottom-color:var(--selected,#ee0000);font-weight:700;}.ds-view:hover{color:var(--ink,#151515);border-bottom-color:#707070;background:var(--raised,#f2f2f2);}.ds-view-active:hover{border-bottom-color:var(--selected,#ee0000);}.ds-view:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#0066cc);outline-offset:3px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-view{transition:border-color 160ms ease-out;}}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-view{padding:12px 16px;}}

narrative.overview:
A precise, approachable team workspace grounded in the user-selected Red Hat design language. The black masthead, neutral content surfaces, Red Hat typefaces, red selected-view accent, and blue interactions give dense repository information a consistent visual hierarchy.

This is a local implementation in native HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, rather than an installation of the RHDS component runtime. The shipped stylesheet is the authority for implementation details; official RHDS references explain the selected language. Light and dark themes use the same structure and adapt their neutral, interaction, and status colors.
keyCharacteristics: Black masthead with neutral light and dark work surfaces.
Red Hat Display for prominent headings and metrics; Red Hat Text for body copy and controls.
Red selected-view underline, blue interactions, and explicit icon-and-label statuses.
Flat, square information panels with subtly rounded action controls.

rules.name: The Selection and Action Rule
rules.body: Reserve UI red for the selected view; the official Red Hat logo retains its brand red. Use blue for links and focus indicators.

rules.name: The Flat Workspace Rule
rules.body: Separate information with neutral surface changes and one-pixel dividers; do not add ornamental shadows.

rules.name: The Status Has Words Rule
rules.body: Keep the status icon and readable label together; color is an additional signal.

dos: Do inherit Red Hat Text on buttons, inputs, and selects.
Do use the theme variables for surfaces, text, borders, links, and statuses.
Do keep selected-view styling and the pressed state synchronized.
Do retain visible labels, keyboard focus, source links, and the distinction between declared support, configured CI coverage, and Actions outcomes.
donts: Don't replace the black masthead or Red Hat typefaces with a new visual identity.
Don't turn workspace panels or filter fields into rounded cards or pill controls.
Don't communicate status through color alone or present configured CI coverage as a successful test run.
Don't claim that the local native controls are the RHDS component runtime.
